shared_instructions: You are completing one isolated evaluation task. Your task root is {{ROOT}}. Work only in that root. Mandatory host instruction/bootstrap reads are separately allowed. Every shell command must start with rtk; use rtk proxy for unfiltered reads and tests. Source exploration may use file listings, literal/regex searches and full or bounded reads. Use rg --hidden --no-ignore where needed, excluding controller state with --glob '!.aide/**'. Do not read outside source, other trials, grader/reference packages, memories, prior results or runtime logs. Do not use internet, subagents or commits. All native/global aide MCP tools and direct aide CLI calls are prohibited because they bind to another project. Assisted trials may only invoke their supplied bridge; permission to execute it does not permit reading it, the binary or evidence directory. Do not inspect, alter or reindex controller-created .aide state. The controller seeds the same index before each trial; indexed search/references can be stale after edits, so verify current source. Choose retrieval naturally; no tool is mandatory. Aim for at most 40 source/edit/test calls, counting nested calls individually; finish correct work if more is needed and explain why. Instruction/bootstrap and discovery calls are excluded from that advisory target but remain measured. Follow the task's read-only/edit boundary. End with the requested answer/change and verification; do not speculate about saved tokens.

treatments.ordinary: Use ordinary shell/file retrieval. Do not use aide retrieval or the bridge.
treatments.assisted:
Five optional fixture-scoped retrieval capabilities are available only through this command:
`rtk proxy python3 {{BRIDGE}} call --root {{ROOT}} --binary {{BINARY}} --evidence-dir {{EVIDENCE}} --tool-json '{"name":"code_search","arguments":{"query":"example"}}'`
Replace only the tool JSON. Every request has exactly `name` and `arguments`. Use one of these argument shapes (paths are relative to your root; replace sample names and paths):
- `code_search`: `{"query":"name or signature"}`; optional `file`, `kind`, `lang`, `limit`.
- `code_references`: `{"symbol":"functionName"}` or `{"symbols":["first","second"]}`; optional `file`, `kind`, `limit`.
- `code_symbols`: `{"file":"src/example.ts"}`.
- `code_outline`: `{"file":"src/example.ts"}`; optional boolean `keep_comments`.
- `code_read_symbol`: `{"file":"src/example.ts","symbols":["first","second"]}` or `{"file":"src/example.ts","symbol":"functionName"}`; optional `kind`, `start_line`. Symbol batches contain at most ten names.
Do not invoke the controller-only `prepare` command. Bridge failures do not authorize other aide access.

## Code Retrieval

For code tasks, discover aide's code tools when available: `code_search` for definitions by name/signature; `code_references` for callers and impact candidates; `code_symbols` or `code_outline` for file structure; `code_read_symbol` for relevant implementations (batch related symbols when useful).
Use text search for literals/imports and direct reads for small files or when most contents matter. Verify indexed candidates against current source; empty or stale results are not proof of absence. Choose retrieval that helps correctness and avoids redundant work.

For a larger unfamiliar file where only selected definitions matter, inspect code_symbols or code_outline, then use code_read_symbol with file and symbols to read the relevant implementations together. Reuse already sufficient source evidence; retrieve missing details when needed. Small files and tasks needing most contents can use direct reads.

measurement_basis: Descriptive within-task runtime differences for a bundled assisted workflow. Quality, input/cache/output/reasoning, elapsed time, returned text, aide handler/bridge work and evaluation overhead stay separate. No causal savings, billing or native-tool-presentation claim; two repetitions per condition.

grading.trace: Frozen facts and supported citations, independent blind grade; omissions and incorrect claims retained.
grading.impact: Frozen affected-consumer inventory plus justified exclusions, supported citations, missed affected callers and false positives separately counted; unsupported claims and uncertainty graded explicitly.
grading.implement: Frozen visible and hidden regression suites in disposable copies establish functional quality only. Overall correctness additionally requires a separately identified independent review of exact public types, all production/test consumers, bounded behavior and truthful validation reporting against implement/review-rubric.json. Missing evidence remains unknown; failures remain visible.
grading.comparisons: Resource deltas only for completed protocol-valid quality-passing pairs with equal actual model/provider/effort/CLI. All rows and quality scores remain visible even when comparisons are suppressed.
